# 0.1.1-beta.15.4

Beta.15.4 refreshes Shibumi's AI, CPU, Memory, and media panels and improves
notification history, picker text, and the Control Center.

## Highlights

- The compact AI panel shows a seven-day token chart, reported limit windows
  with reset countdowns and pace, and the plan name when available. Text uses
  consistent sizes for labels, content, and values.
  The AI widget keeps its value when a provider refresh times out.
- The CPU panel now follows the Memory panel's layout, with a water-filled
  load ring, CPU model, and load averages. A GPU row appears after reported
  activity; the title follows its visibility as "CPU" or "CPU · GPU".
- The Memory panel combines a water-filled load ring with GiB values and,
  when available, RAM type and speed in MT/s.
- The water rings in the CPU and Memory panels move gently while a panel is
  open.
- The media panel has five rounded buttons in one row: Shuffle, Previous,
  Play/Pause, Next, and Repeat. Shuffle, Repeat, and seeking are available
  where the player supports them.
- Notifications are counted without opening the panel, grouped by app, and
  shown with relative times. Clicking a Recent entry focuses an existing
  window of its app.
- Hearthstone picker card titles stay sharp while the cards are transformed.
- The compact Control Center no longer clips the Health page.
- Buttons in the redesigned panels follow the panel's corner radius.

## Compatibility

Beta.15.4 targets the repository's pinned Omarchy 4.0.4 package and source
baselines with Quickshell 0.3.1. It does not update Omarchy.

Update a Beta.15 through Beta.15.3 source installation from its existing checkout:

```bash
git fetch --tags
git checkout v0.1.1-beta.15.4
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

## Notes

- On the pinned Omarchy 4.0.x hosts, the plugin API does not expose Live
  popups. Shibumi therefore shows Recent history and omits the Live section
  from the tooltip.
- Source checkouts cloned with a restrictive `umask` such as 077 now keep a
  stable payload identity. If an earlier release was installed from such a
  checkout and `update` is refused, uninstall with the release you had
  installed while keeping your settings, then install Beta.15.4:

  ```bash
  git checkout v0.1.1-beta.15.2  # the tag you had installed
  ./scripts/shibumi-suite uninstall --keep-settings --yes
  git checkout v0.1.1-beta.15.4
  ./scripts/shibumi-suite install --yes
  ```
- The notes of 0.1.1-beta.15 remain valid.
- AUR publication remains deferred.
